# Sunset Sprinklers LLC

> Professional sprinkler and drip irrigation repair services in Albuquerque, NM, specializing in RainBird and Hunter systems with smart WiFi timer installation.

Sunset Sprinklers LLC, led by Johnny Carter, provides comprehensive irrigation system maintenance, repair, and installation throughout Albuquerque and East Albuquerque. The company specializes in modern smart irrigation solutions including WiFi-enabled timers, valve inspection, and seasonal system start-up services.
